executionConstraints.outlinePointAccess: explicit optional provider; no bytecode execution

cmap.scope: Unicode formats 4 and 12; variation sequences format 14

head.scope: Version 1.0 complete immutable field model including signed 64-bit dates and declared bounds; bounds of non-default instances derived separately

hhea.scope: Version 1.0 complete metrics/caret/count model with reserved fields checked

hmtx.scope: Horizontal advances and left side bearings, including repeated final advance

maxp.scope: Versions 0.5/1.0 complete declared profile fields; declarations do not replace application resource budgets or validate every instruction

name.scope: Versions 0/1 complete record/language-tag model; explicit UTF-16BE/ASCII and Macintosh Roman decoders; other platform codecs and locale matching require application capabilities

OS/2.scope: Versions 0–5 all fields including legacy 68-byte v0, versioned embedding semantics and optical ranges; declared coverage is not glyph coverage, MVAR adjustment separate

post.scope: Versions 1/2/2.5/3 headers and native standard/indexed/offset glyph names or explicit absent names; MVAR adjustment separate

cvt.scope: Immutable signed design values; cvar interpolation separate from rasterizer control-value access

fpgm.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

glyf.scope: Simple/composite decoding, unhinted component assembly with explicit offset policy, quadratic paths, optional gvar instance, explicit phantom-point attachment and USE_MY_METRICS; instruction execution excluded

loca.scope: Short and long glyph offsets bounded against maxp and glyf

prep.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

gasp.scope: Versions 0/1 native ordered ppem recommendation lookup; MVAR threshold adjustment and actual rasterization separate

CFF.scope: INDEX/DICT/FDSelect, charset/encodings, explicit FontMatrix and unhinted Type 2 programs including subroutines, arithmetic and deprecated composites; rasterizer hint application and high-level semantics of all DICT metadata excluded

CFF2.scope: INDEX/DICT/FDSelect, unhinted cubic programs and explicit native variation blends, PrivateDICT blend evaluation; rasterizer hint application excluded

VORG.scope: Version 1.0 default and sparse CFF/CFF2 origins; explicitly unusable for TrueType

SVG.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

EBDT.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

EBLC.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

EBSC.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

CBDT.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

CBLC.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

sbix.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

BASE.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

GDEF.scope: Versions1.0/1.2/1.3: glyph/mark classes, mark filtering sets, attachment point lists, caret formats1–3, native ItemVariationStore; actual hinted point access remains an explicit application capability

GPOS.scope: Types1–9, all contextual formats, pair/class adjustments, cursive and mark attachments, signed Device tables, VariationIndex and native FeatureVariations with explicit positions/scale/normalized instance

GSUB.scope: Types1–8, all contextual formats, script/language/feature selection and native FeatureVariations condition format1; explicit alternate and normalized coordinate policies

JSTF.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

MATH.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

avar.scope: Version 1.0 piecewise axis maps in original fvar order; missing mandatory anchors disable the affected map; avar 2 excluded

cvar.scope: Version 1.0 tuple-store evaluation at explicit coordinates, preserving fractional unscaled CVT values; device scaling and VM separate

fvar.scope: Version 1.0 ordered axes and named instances, explicit tagged user coordinates and default/clamped 16.16 to 2.14 normalization

gvar.scope: Version 1.0 shared/embedded/intermediate tuples and packed data; explicit native sparse contour interpolation, composite placement and phantom deltas before instruction execution

HVAR.scope: Version 1.0 native advance and optional bearing deltas; explicit instance, implicit/mapped indices, absent bearing data remains null

MVAR.scope: Version 1.0 complete value records and native tagged deltas; explicit default-metric adjustment without hidden mutation

STAT.scope: Versions 1.0/1.1/1.2 all axis/value formats, flags, links and explicit coordinate matching; locale/name projection policy remains application-supplied

VVAR.scope: Version 1.0 native advance, optional bearing and vertical-origin deltas; explicit instance and absent-data semantics

COLR.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

CPAL.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

DSIG.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

hdmx.scope: Version 0 ordered pixel-width records with explicit ppem selection; no scaler invocation

kern.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

LTSH.scope: Version 0 complete per-glyph thresholds and explicit declared-linear comparison; no verification by instruction execution

MERG.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

meta.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

PCLT.scope: Raw table bytes available; semantic model and execution pending

VDMX.scope: Versions 0/1 ratio ranges, shared height groups and explicit character-set/resolution/ppem selection; no interpolation or rasterization

vhea.scope: Versions 1.0/1.1 complete header model and versioned field meanings

vmtx.scope: Vertical advances and top side bearings including repeated final advance
